request.caption: Epic cinematic rock instrumental: a heroic melodic lead guitar theme over driving orchestral rock drums and big toms, low brass and strings playing a strong ostinato riff, distorted guitar power chords, a rising build into a huge triumphant peak where the brass and the lead guitar play the theme together, urgent and fiery, warm full mid-range, modern cinematic production, wide stereo mix with brass and strings panned left and right, spacious hall reverb, no vocals
